method: Each definition in s21-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The integration file runs the real route handler POST /api/v1/buyer/suggestions as envoi_web on a local PostgreSQL database built from the migrations, with DATABASE_URL removed, holding the seeded demo FIXTURE shop and, for one case, two extra FIXTURE shops it removes again; OpenAI is faked at the provider's fetch boundary by tests/support/fake-openai.ts, labeled FIXTURE, so no model is called and PayPal is never reached. The unit file reads src/app/buy/one-box.ts and the two client components that use it. Every definition here is an S21 test recorded in 00-status.md.
